verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe entity-scoped memory with user_id, agent_id, app_id, and session scoping so memories 'land exactly where they belong' and are separated across users/agents/apps, matching the tenancy story directly (mem0-docs-9, mem0-docs-30, mem0-docs-35). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that isolation is enforced at retrieval time (no cross-tenant leakage tested), and no detail on access-control enforcement (e.g., can a request with wrong user_id still retrieve another user's memories) beyond first-party docs.
